description: vsftpd.conf security audit — Offline audit of a vsftpd.conf (text= the file). Checks anonymous login and anonymous upload/mkdir/rename (CRITICAL), plain-FTP logins without TLS, optional TLS for logins/data, SSLv2/SSLv3/TLS 1.0/1.1, weak ssl_ciphers, missing certificate, chroot_local_user and allow_writeable_chroot, weak local/anon umask, user allow lists, seccomp sandbox and isolation, privilege-separation overrides, FTP bounce (pasv/port_promiscuous), passive port range, interface binding, transfer logging, connection limits, version banners and hide_ids. Returns findings with severity and fix, unknown keys, duplicates, score/grade, PASS / REVIEW / FIX BEFORE DEPLOY / BLOCK and a hardened example config. Nothing is stored. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_vsftpd_check
